content: {"episode_id":"ep-05043","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, which the payer letter states was denied because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of symptomatic atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome, consistent with diagnosis codes I48.91, I49.5, and I49.9. Per that note, given the history of unexplained cardiac arrhythmias and the need to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous electrocardiographic data during daily activities. We request reprocessing of the 692.33 outstanding balance on the basis of this documented medical necessity."}
